methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The object of research is the relationship between 4 different standards but has the same space, namely environmental standards and sustainability

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Conceptual comparison of the principles of ISO 14001, ISO 50001, Green Building and ZEB standards aimed at integrating them; EnPIs and SEUs are mentioned only incidentally as ISO 50001 clauses/parameters, with no EnPI/EnB measurement model identified or characterised (no variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach).

paper_type.evidence_quote: This research uses descriptive exploratory analysis method

stage1.notes: Mentions Significant Energy Users (SEUs) and Energy Performance Indicators (EnPIs) only as ISO 50001 parameters; no measurement model is presented or characterised, so ineligible under the v2.3 threshold.
